evidence: arXiv 2008.07069, Lam, Dietrich, Pearce, 'to be published as Onward! Essays 2020'. Abstract names contracts, traditional and lightweight, as a promising input to semantic version calculators that help developers upgrade safely.

arXiv 2112.10328, Hatfield-Dodds and Dygalo. Abstract: Schemathesis derives structure- and semantics-aware fuzzers from schemas, tested on 16 services, finding 1.4 to 4.5 times more unique defects than the next-best fuzzer per target.
correction: The arXiv page lists no venue. ICSE 2022 Companion (poster) is from memory [verify]; DBLP was blocked. Say 'unique defects' and 'per target'.

evidence: The checks page has response_schema_conformance ('Validates the response body against its JSON Schema definition') and ensure_resource_availability ('created resources are immediately accessible'). Stateful checks 'only trigger when links between operations are available.'
correction: Drop 'links inferred automatically'. The stateful-testing guide says links come from the schema, plus links the CLI learns from Location headers. Without links you must define OpenAPI links yourself.

evidence: MSR page: Atlidakis, Godefroid, Polishchuk, ICSE 2019. Abstract: 'This paper introduces RESTler, the first stateful REST API fuzzer.' and 'RESTler found 28 bugs in GitLab.'
correction: 'First' is the authors' self-description; attribute it to them.

evidence: README: 'More than 30 oracles are currently used', including 500 status codes, mismatches from the API schemas, BOLA, and SQL injection. Black-box works on any API; white-box is JVM only. Source is LGPL (v3).

ISSTA 2023 page, Alonso, Segura, Ruiz-Cortes: 'total precision of 81.2% ... 11 operations from 7 industrial APIs'; 'detected 6 out of every 10 errors systematically seeded'; 'revealed 11 bugs in APIs with millions of users'.

Ernst page, TOSEM 2025, Alonso, Ernst, Segura, Ruiz-Cortes: 'precision of 80% on 25 operations from 20 industrial APIs'; 'identified 48% of errors systematically seeded'; 'uncovered 32 bugs'. Replication package at doi 10.5281/zenodo.14728849.
